message.reasoning_content:
We need to produce a correction rule to prevent the AI from misclassifying crimes. The wrong prediction included many charges: illegal intrusion, rape, forced indecency, intentional injury. Correct answer: "强奸;侮辱". So the error: overcharging with too many specific crimes, not recognizing that certain acts are subsumed under "侮辱" (maybe "侮辱罪" for sexual assault of elderly?). Actually Chinese criminal law: For sexual assault on elderly, may be "强奸罪" and "侮辱罪"? The case: attempted rape (genitals not inserted) plus oral insertion, plus assault causing light injury. Under Chinese law, if sexual assault without penetration, it's "强制猥亵罪". But they said correct answer is "强奸;侮辱". So maybe the classification expects "强奸罪" (rape) and "侮辱罪" (insult) for the oral insertion? The error included "非法侵入住宅罪" (illegal intrusion) which is not charged because intrusion is part of rape? Also "强制猥亵罪" and "故意伤害罪" are not separate because the injury is result of rape, maybe included in rape? So rule: Do not list separate offenses for acts that are already covered by a higher-level charge; only include the most appropriate charge(s) per Chinese criminal law hierarchy.

Thus rule: When multiple criminal acts are part of a single statutory offense (e.g., illegal entry, assault, and sexual assault that constitute rape), only assign the principal charge(s) and omit subordinate or overlapping charges.

Keywords: "非法侵入住宅", "强制猥亵", "故意伤害", "多罪并罚", "同一行为包含多罪".
